"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/day-of-the-year/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1154. Day of the Year

Given a string date representing a Gregorian calendar date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD, return the day number of the year.

Example 1:

Input: date = "2019-01-09"
Output: 9
Explanation: Given date is the 9th day of the year in 2019.

Example 2:

Input: date = "2019-02-10"
Output: 41

Constraints:

    date.length == 10
    date[4] == date[7] == '-'
    all other date[i]'s are digits
    date represents a calendar date between Jan 1st, 1900 and Dec 31st, 2019.
"""


class Solution:
    def dayOfYear(self, date: str) -> int:
        year, month, day = map(int, date.split("-"))
        # Days in each month for non-leap year
        days_in_month = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]

        # Check for leap year
        is_leap = (year % 400 == 0) or (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0)
        if is_leap:
            days_in_month[1] = 29

        return sum(days_in_month[: month - 1]) + day


sol = Solution()

print(sol.dayOfYear("2019-01-09"))  # 9

assert sol.dayOfYear("2019-01-09") == 9
assert sol.dayOfYear("2019-02-10") == 41

assert Solution().dayOfYear("1900-01-01") == 1
assert Solution().dayOfYear("1900-12-31") == 365
assert Solution().dayOfYear("2000-02-29") == 60
assert Solution().dayOfYear("2019-12-31") == 365
assert Solution().dayOfYear("2016-02-29") == 60
assert Solution().dayOfYear("2016-03-01") == 61

assert Solution().dayOfYear("1900-02-28") == 59
assert Solution().dayOfYear("2019-03-01") == 60
assert Solution().dayOfYear("2019-07-04") == 185
assert Solution().dayOfYear("2019-11-30") == 334
assert Solution().dayOfYear("2019-02-28") == 59
